parameters.content:
## Module 1 — Data collection & validation
Entry: **Execute Workflow Trigger** receiving envelope `{ client_id, client_config?, data:{subject,text} }`.

**Config Provided?** skips the Notion lookup when the orchestrator already passed `client_config` (resolve-once). Standalone runs fall through to **Load Client Registry**.

**Validate & Flag Missing Fields** is deterministic code — it produces `missing_fields` + `data.status` (fixes gap G3), not the LLM.

Standalone production deployments add their own trigger (Gmail/webhook) that builds the envelope, then call this workflow.
